using CUDA

maxdiff(a, b) = begin
    fa = collect(Float64, vec(collect(a))); fb = collect(Float64, vec(collect(b)))
    length(fa) != length(fb) && return Inf
    isempty(fa) && return 0.0
    m = 0.0
    for i in eachindex(fa)
        s = max(abs(fa[i]), abs(fb[i]), 1.0)
        m = max(m, abs(fa[i] - fb[i]) / s)
    end
    m
end
